item.title: Re: (Looking for greenlight) Ancient elevators
item.content:encoded:
+ Open for critique
- Behold!

I absolutely love this. As I was reading I was concerned that this lacked a punchline, but you cleared that quickly.

A few points of advice.
Make sure that list of elevators does not drag and has a rise in bizarreness. You shouldn't start with the pyramids or a recognizable location. You should also expound upon how these machines work, mainly for world building and such. There's some cool imagery here that could be fun reading.

I'm not sure an MTF log is exactly needed. That could be taking up unnecessary space to establish team members, what they're doing, and so on before all the action. Keep the whole satellite detection point, but just have a Foundation doctor communicate over a transmission system of some sort. You should be going for the energy of SCP-3197.

I do feel like the aliens landing on Earth is unneeded. If their whole MO was to "uplift" the human species, them coming back every, say, 1000 years to monitor the Earth would make a bit more sense and also explain why the Foundation has never interacted with them before.

Definite greenlight from me. Good luck and be sure to reach out to other reviewers!

item.title: Re: (Looking for greenlight) Ancient elevators
item.content:encoded:
Ahh, thank you for the review, you raise some good points.

What if, instead of the art of elevator installation propagating throughout human culture on it's own, it's isolated incidents of ancient people being told how to make an elevator? The foundation's treatment of the anomaly would probably then be more justified. I guess that would also partially justify the aliens only visiting after 4000 years (which should actually have said 5000 cuz I'm bad at math).

As for your last concern, what if I focused the reveal less on "how are ancient people building elevators?", and more on "why are ancient people being taught how to build elevators?"? I could say/imply right out of the gate that it's goofy green aliens, and I could keep the punchline where they've misconstrued the meaning of "uplift".

item.title: Re: (Looking for greenlight) Ancient elevators
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open for crit
– hide block

The Foundation puts out the story that the first elevator was installed in 1880, and whenever they find an elevator created before that date, they either destroy it, conceal it, or make it look like a modern elevator.

…why? I think the crux of my problem is that this entire SCP relies on us assuming the Foundation has a good reason to conceal ancient elevators but there's not really like…any reason present here for us to assume that? Indeed, the existence of ancient elevators implies that people would naturally be pretty okay with them existing ages ago cos like…everyone would've seen them and be aware of it so it just feels weird that the Foundation intervene at all?

When it hits the surface, aliens pop out, and explain that 4000 yeas ago, they gave the gift of elevators to man, having misinterpreted instructions from the alien queen to "uplift" our species.

why did it take the aliens 4000 years to realise their mistake?

I don't really have big concerns other than these, but my concern is that not having good answers to these will mean this loses the verisimilitude this needs for us to accept the premise enough that the reveal doesn't land right.

I'm…also of a mind that leaving this open might be more effective than saying it was aliens: something like SCP-4466 might be a good touchstone for this where it's like…something normal but treated in a very alien way and where the strangeness works cos there's no resolution to it? Like for me this would work best if there's a moment where the reader is like 'wait are these elevators' followed immediately by 'these are elevators but wrong', y'know? My concern with aliens is that it feels a little too much like a deus ex machina where the answer just, appears from thin air with no build up; and so it feels like the arc might feel unsatisfying? There's this big mystery about what these things are and instead of the foundation solving it, the answer just jumps out and says it's the answer, y'know?

item.title: (Looking for greenlight) Ancient elevators
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Comedy / Bizarre (if that counts as a category)

Elevator Pitch:

  • According to the public, the elevator was invented and popularized in the late 1800's.
  • In actuality, the first elevators popped up around 3000 BC.
  • Functional elevators can be found in historic buildings; there's even ancient Egyptian elevators in the great pyramids.

Central Narrative:
The containment procedures and description serve to introduce the anomaly and explain how the Foundation is handling it. The Foundation puts out the story that the first elevator was installed in 1880, and whenever they find an elevator created before that date, they either destroy it, conceal it, or make it look like a modern elevator. It also serves to justify some aspects of the anomaly, like how elevators could be invented before electricity, or how knowledge of how to build an elevator could propagate in the first place.

+ show block
– hide block

Then there's an addendum explaining some notable examples of ancient elevators, which serve both to clarify the anomaly further and act as their own interesting anecdotes. Examples I have in mind are solid stone elevators installed into the great pyramids, how elevators are used in various medieval castles, and possibly even mentions of elevators in the bible.

The resolution to the SCP comes in the form of an MTF log. Foundation satellites detect an object manifest in space and slowly descend to the earth's surface. An MTF squad is deployed to the estimated landing zone, and discover it to be a descending elevator. When it hits the surface, aliens pop out, and explain that 4000 yeas ago, they gave the gift of elevators to man, having misinterpreted instructions from the alien queen to "uplift" our species.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
It might be ambitious for a first SCP, but if I go with the "aliens taught us how to make elevators" story, the hook could be that the object class is Explained, with the subclass of Keter, since even though the anomaly is explained the phenomenon still requires coverup procedures.

Alternatively, the hook could just be an incredibly jarring phrase in the containment procedures, like "Highly visible elevators installed in notable historic sites, such as the main lobby elevator of the Great Pyramid of Giza…".

Additional Notes:
Some of my favorite SCPs are the ones that are just about something straight up bizarre, like 5940 or 5319 or 2598 or 4062. Something about them appeals to me in a huge way, more than horror or drama ever does in SCPs. It's definitely what I wanna try for my first SCP, if it wouldn't be too much of a challenge.
